_comment: Phase 2 input: the only change is the synchronous policy, widened to all four nodes. Re-running the same playbook with this must converge the running cluster onto ANY 1 (postgres01..04) on every promotion candidate.
_comment_pgbackrest: pgBackRest encrypts its repository by default (repo_cipher_type aes-256-cbc) and refuses to configure without a passphrase. A throwaway value here; a real deployment supplies this from its secret store.
